notes.title: Your Day 1 Update is here!
notes.notes:
There is a second level
Enemies do better using their mana on their weapons
Initial info on elemental shields displayed when paused
Mid-Battle saving of fire is less inflammatory
Music further improved
Weapon hover-descriptions small update

notes.title: First update of the playtest
notes.notes: Much has changed since last castles were rolling out. This first update is a test of deployment speed in preparation of the incoming real playtest.
